bull_bear.body: - Debt rising (~INR370cr) to fund expansion; debt/equity targeted ~0.5x. No equity raise signaled. OCF INR196.9cr (~25%+ of EBITDA); focus on sustaining better customer payment terms (credit period, multiple customers — explicitly "not one-time advances"). No buyback/dividend commentary.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Margin pass-through risk from commodity/freight inflation amid geopolitics (already hit FY26 ~170bps).
- Customer concentration in clean energy (Bloom anchor); potential new vendors as Bloom scales — mgmt downplays (steep learning curve, 12-15 yr partnership).
- Execution / capacity-ramp & headcount-training risk on aggressive 80% guide.
- Order-timing/deferral risk (INR250cr nuclear/defence slipped); tender-dependent nuclear & defence inflows.
- Forex: >70% export revenue — INR25cr forex gain a tailwind but two-way risk; hedging policy vague.
- Fluence dropped (US battery duties) — lost optionality.
- Rising debt during expansion.
bull_bear.title: Risks

bull_bear.body: Confident-to-bullish. MD raised guidance materially and repeatedly stressed "much stronger position," "on track," visibility-driven capacity build. Candid on margin miss and Fluence drop. Guarded (NDA) on Bloom quantums and FY30 revenue timing. CFO supportive with operating-leverage math.
bull_bear.title: Mgmt tone

bull_bear.body:
- AI-data-center assemblies booked under **Clean Energy** segment (not a new head); SLB straddles both clean energy (data-center) and oil & gas.
- Nuclear assets fully **fungible across PHWR and FBR** technologies — reduces tech-bet risk.
- Tejas/LCA actuator order is **free-issue material** — reported value is value-add only, not gross order value.
- Margin dip is cost/deliverables-driven, NOT customer price renegotiation (mgmt emphatic).
- FY27 growth front-loaded — break from MTAR's historical weak-H1 seasonality.
- AMCA: two distinct tenders — full integration (Adani-linked, not won) vs structural assemblies (MTAR won INR4cr, 1 of 8 vendors).
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious

bull_bear.body:
- Strategic priorities include maintaining capital discipline by prioritising opportunities with strong growth potential and attractive returns, and enhancing ROCE through efficient deployment and improved asset utilisation.
- Aims to strengthen cash flows by reducing net working capital through inventory optimisation, improved collections, and favourable payment terms, while maintaining a healthy balance sheet.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **Clean energy** (Bloom + SLB data-center): largest, fastest-growing; ~70% of FY27 incremental. Hot-box capacity "multifold" expansion underway, NDA-bound (no numbers). AI-data-center value-add ~70%, "pretty profitable."
- **Nuclear**: strongest-ever order book INR650cr+; fungible assets across PHWR/FBR; qualified for Calandria & end-shields; refurbishment of 5 reactors + new reactors (ASHVINI/Mahi Banswara tenders FY27). Scaling from Q2.
- **Defence & Aerospace**: INR360cr+; volume production commenced for some MNC customers; IAI first articles done by Sept, volume Oct; domestic — landing gears, structural & actuator assemblies.
- **Oil & gas**: whipstock assemblies; dedicated plant operational Sept; one-plant potential INR450-500cr over 3-4 yrs; opportunity $35-40mn per anchor customer; adding multiple customers.
- **Product division (ball screws)**: to cross INR200cr in FY26; now qualified for MNC ball-screw supplies.

business.body:

- Established a Nadcap-accredited special processes facility with approvals covering more than 30 processes, a capability held by only a select few companies in India, demonstrating deep process expertise and comprehensive in-house manufacturing.

latest_quarter.body: - FY26 EBITDA margin 19.5% (missed ~21% +/-1% guide) due to ~170bps gross-margin compression (input/consumable cost + freight from geopolitics) and higher headcount from expansion. Gross margin 47.7% vs 49.4%. Mgmt firmly denies any price renegotiation with clean-energy customer; attributes dip to costs/deliverables. FY27 margin guided to recover to ~24% on operating leverage.
latest_quarter.title: Margins

latest_quarter.body:
- First captured quarter in this repository (no prior MTARTECH_*.md). Comparisons drawn from in-call references to the previous quarter/call.
- **Guidance raised**: FY27 revenue growth 50% → 80% (+/-5%); FY27 EBITDA margin guided ~24%.
- **New disclosure**: AI-data-center assemblies customer (SLB) — INR35cr first-article order, INR400-500cr potential.
- **Order book**: closed INR2,580cr vs INR2,800cr guided (INR250cr nuclear/defence deferred); Q4 intake INR481cr.
- **Working capital**: net WC days 172 vs ~267-278 prior quarter — sharp improvement; OCF INR196.9cr vs INR101cr LY.
- **Fluence dropped** from customer base (flagged in prior call) due to US battery duties.
- **Margin**: FY26 19.5% missed ~21%(+/-1%) guide on cost inflation + headcount; gross margin 47.7% vs 49.4%.
- **Capex**: INR250-300cr over FY27-28 (Bloom multifold); debt rising to ~INR370cr, D/E target ~0.5x.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **FY27 revenue growth raised to 80% (+/-5%)** from prior 50% (implies ~INR1,575-1,650cr / ~INR16bn). Clean energy ~70% of incremental, rest across verticals.
- **FY27 EBITDA margin ~24%** (vs 19.5% FY26); CFO cites ~5% operating leverage on ~28% fixed-cost base.
- **FY27 closing order book guided ~INR5,000cr** (vs INR2,580cr now) → implies ~INR4,000cr inflows in FY27.
- FY27 growth front-loaded: "very good first half and a much better second half" (reversal of FY26's weak-H1 pattern).
- Debt/equity targeted ~0.5x over next 2 yrs.
- Aspirational INR5,000cr **revenue** road map by ~FY30 (not committed); needs ~INR500-700cr cumulative capex.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body:
- Closing FY26 order book **INR2,580cr** (vs INR2,800cr guided; ~INR250cr nuclear/defence orders deferred to current quarter — timing only, no outlook impact).
- Q4 order intake **INR481cr**.
- Segment order-book color: Nuclear INR650cr+ (execute over 3-3.5 yrs); Defence & Aerospace INR360cr+.
- AI-data-center: INR35cr first-article export order booked; INR400-500cr potential over 2 yrs.
- AMCA structural-assembly first win INR4cr (1 of 8 qualified vendors); LCA Mk1A Tejas actuator order INR130-150cr expected this quarter (free-issue material → value-add only).
outlook.title: Order book

outlook.body: - FY26 revenue +30% YoY; raised FY27 to 80% (+/-5%). Multi-vertical: clean energy fastest, but nuclear/defence/oil-gas growing in absolute terms too. Exports >70% of revenue; imports 30-35%.
outlook.title: Growth

deepdive.thesis: MTAR is at an inflection: FY27 revenue guidance raised sharply from ~50% to 80% (+/-5%) growth on a record FY26 base (INR876cr), powered by commissioned clean-energy capacity (Bloom), a commencing oil & gas plant (Sept), the strongest-ever nuclear order book (INR650cr+), and aerospace volume production. New optionality from AI-data-center assemblies (INR400-500cr potential over 2 yrs, INR35cr first orders booked). Working capital and cash flow finally inflecting positively.
